correctness.rationale: The base-four parity digit formula t_{Bm+r}=t_m xor t_r for B a fourth power is proved by substitution. For B>1031*d, each progression of length <=1032 crosses at most one high-digit boundary. The choices m=0 (same low colors) and m=1 (opposite colors) make the separate before/after low-bit-constant criterion necessary and sufficient over EVERY starting position. Intersecting exact masks over all B residues proves existence and its first failure for each d; no cap is attained. Independently reimplemented a different residue bit-mask enumerator for all 1,025 d, including witness-start reconstruction; generated the exact same 11,605-byte AP_PROFILE.csv (Git blob SHA 5b536a833af2f8442256e68ff1b250d60f0bba82). The resulting unique maxima/second values are (65,66,64), (255,260,258), (1025,1026,1024). These are exhaustive finite-difference proofs, not infinite-difference conclusions.

value.rationale: Cutoffs 4^3+1=65, 4^4+1=257 and 4^5+1=1025 are dictated by Conjecture 30, not arbitrary range slices. An exact all-differences profile and uniqueness of maximizing shifts resolves three concrete finite conjecture scales and yields exact witnesses useful for future patterns.

final_claim: For the one-sided 0011/1100 substitution fixed point, the exact infinite-start monochromatic arithmetic-progression maxima A(d) are computed for all differences 1<=d<=1025, with witnesses in AP_PROFILE.csv; successive cutoff maxima are 66 uniquely at d=65, 260 uniquely at d=255, 1026 uniquely at d=1025.
limitations: Exactly 1<=d<=1025 for this substitution fixed point; no general all-d proof.
The 1032 bound is justified by checked first-zero masks; it is not a timeout certificate.
